test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What sum of money (in Rs.) will amount to Rs. 20,400 at the rate of 9% per annum simple interest in four years?
solution:
**Given:**

Amount (A) = ₹20,400

Rate (r) = 9% per annum

Time (t) = 4 years

**Formula used:**

A = P + (P × r × t) / 100

Where, P = Principal

**Calculation:**

20,400 = P + (P × 9 × 4) / 100

⇒ 20,400 = P + (36P) / 100

⇒ 20,400 = P × (1 + 36/100)

⇒ 20,400 = P × 1.36

⇒ P = 20,400 ÷ 1.36

⇒ P = ₹15,000

**∴ The required sum of money is ₹15,000.**
